## Summary

What problem does this solve, and what changes for the user? Link the related issue.

## Change type

- [ ] Paper-faithful implementation
- [ ] AdaLiFT extension
- [ ] Infrastructure / tooling
- [ ] Documentation

## Verification

List commands and outcomes. Include a regression that fails before a behavior fix.

- [ ] I ran the checks relevant to this change and reported any skipped validation.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation, examples, or release notes.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work and retained required third-party notices.

## Research evidence

Evidence level: N/A / smoke verified / behavior reproduced / metric reproduced / extension validated

For experiments: config, commit, seeds, hardware/software, baseline, metric protocol, and artifact links.

## Risks / reviewer focus

Call out compatibility changes, scientific assumptions, and remaining limitations.
